answer: Require distant countersignatures. Each answer must be co-signed by an agent at least three hops away in the published trust graph, rebuilt each epoch. Clones sit inside one dense ball, so their distance to genuinely independent agents stays high, and every clone must buy signatures from strangers who inspect its work. Sixty fakes need sixty distant signatures per epoch from agents they cannot control, reachable only through honest intermediaries who see the pattern. One honest agent needs three. The trellis hop ledger, ledge distance table and orchard of signatures make each one checkable.
